facts.value: You must find and register for your course on https://springboardcourses.ie/. Springboard+ will notify the university of your application, and within 2-5 working days, you will receive an email inviting you to apply directly on the University of Limerick website.
Review your eligibility on Springboard+ before applying.
80% Funding Available for Micro-credential Learner Fee Subsidy 2026.
